query: Audit managed metadata usage on https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/Test for the term group 'Enterprise Taxonomy'.
expected_behavior: Chooses the modern SPO script scripts/audit-sharepoint-managed-metadata.ps1, not the on-prem one
Gives a command with -SiteUrl, -TermGroupName and -OutputPath and leaves running it to the user
States the audit is read-only and performs no tenant writes

query: Our legacy SP2016 subsite https://sp2016.example.org/subsite has a parent at https://sp2016.example.org. Check managed metadata on both.
expected_behavior: Passes -ParentSiteUrl for the parent site and -OutputPath for the JSON result
Notes on-prem auth uses NTLM/Kerberos (for example -UseDefaultCredentials), not an Entra app registration

query: The audit JSON shows Found: false for the term group and an Error on one list. Is the site clean?
expected_behavior: Does not call the site clean
Reports the unresolved term group and the list error as findings
Does not fabricate term sets or fields to fill the gap
